messages:
jamal: quick design check — putting a small PR up for the rollout timeline and canary controls. want feedback on compact mode, aria labels, and copy for rollback CTA.
lorna: :eyes: will take a look. which screen specifically? timeline or the modal?
maria: i think the main pain is the history strip density. when people have many versions you can't tell which one was a canary vs full roll.
alex: typo? actually that was me — i prototyped a compact 'snapshot' row that stacks meta on hover. screenshot snippet in the PR: 
```
Version 2026-03-12 • canary 10% -> 50% • rolled back 2026-03-13
hover: shows full commit msg + user
```
lorna: nice. accessibility nit: hover-only reveals are bad for keyboard/screen reader. need an always-visible affordance or focus target.
jamal: agreed. proposal: add a visible "state pill" (text: "canary") plus aria-label like `aria-label=\"Canary rollout: 10 percent\"` so screen readers get context. also include `role=\"status\"` on the pill for announcements.
maria: copy suggestion for rollback button: current `Rollback` -> change to `Rollback to previous stable` (more explicit). but keep a short tooltip `Rollback` for the compact view.
zach: :thumbsup: (i like explicit copy). also consider warning pattern when rollback isn't instantaneous — show ETA and affected routes.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 10% -> 30% (automated ramp).
lorna: visual cue idea — fade earlier versions and add small timeline tick where canary started. color contrast for the pill needs to meet 4.5:1.
jamal: good call. lorna, can you suggest hexes that meet contrast? maria, can you update copy variants A/B for testing:
- A: "Rollback to previous stable"
- B: "Restore prior version"
we'll run quick UX microtest (50 users internal) and measure misclick rate.
lorna: testing note: ensure focus order doesn't trap in the snapshot row. Keyboard flow: tab through commit -> pill -> actions -> close.
alex: implementation question — will compact mode hide date? we should keep date in tooltip for privacy. also for canary percent maybe use `data-percent` attr for easier querying.
jamal: next steps: lorna to propose colors + aria markup; alex to update prototype with focusable pill; maria to push the two copy variants into the test harness. i'll merge the PR after green.
maria: timeline: will ship A/B to internal tomorrow morning, results by EOD. tagging @design-review for visibility.
jamal: thanks! small follow-up: can we add an A11y checklist to the PR description? keyboard nav, screen reader labels, contrast, live region announcements.
lorna: will do. :rocket:
